tools.name: createSoundiizImportLink
tools.description: Create a temporary 24-hour Soundiiz import link for 1 to 200 supplied tracks. Show the exact returned shareUrl, including query parameters, and expiry. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. The user reviews the tracks and completes the transfer in Soundiiz. Omit unknown album or IS

tools.name: listSoundiizImportDestinations
tools.description: List configured destinations that can currently receive a Soundiiz playlist import link. Use the returned corename for an import; slug is a public guide identifier and may differ. Does not access an account or check live service health.

tools.name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility
tools.description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two exact public platform slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music. tools.name: createSoundiizImportLinkFromUrl
tools.description: Read a public playlist of at most 200 source items from its full HTTPS URL and create a 24-hour Soundiiz import link.
